description: Async-first Python framework for building typed Home Assistant automations
rules: Bus registration methods (on_state_change, on_attribute_change, on_call_service, on) are async and must be awaited.
Pass name= to every bus listener registration; wait_for is the only exception.
Apps subclass App[MyConfig] where MyConfig subclasses AppConfig, and set up listeners and jobs in async on_initialize.
Handlers receive only the parameters their signature declares; don't add an unused event parameter.
